title: The three-action zero-sum discrepancy-free region
statement:
Let $S=\{s_3,s_2,s_1\}$ with $s_3<s_2<s_1$. Let $o_{\mathrm{zs}}$ denote the zero-sum scoring-play outcome and let the antagonistic self-interest game use AvA tie-breaking. **Three-action discrepancy-free-region conjecture.** There is no discrepancy between these games if

$$
s_2\leq 2s_3\quad\text{or}\quad s_1\geq s_2+s_3.
$$

The claim is inferred from computational plots of the three-action parameter space and is explicitly presented as a conjecture; no proof or resolution is given.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.24280

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2025).
source_name: Anjali Bhagat, Tanmay Kulkarni, Urban Larsson and Divya Murali, “Tie-breaking in self interest cumulative subtraction games”, arXiv:2510.24280 (2026).
